title: Deep Review Finding
description: One candidate defect emitted by a Phase 2 lens. PRODUCER: Phase 2 identify lanes (02-findings/<lens>.json). CONSUMERS: Phase 3a refuters (read claim+evidence+criterion), Phase 3b mechanical verification (reads criterion+verification_plan), Phase 4 triage (reads interface_delta, removes_failure_path, fix_size_loc, blast_radius), Phase 10 ranking (reads severity, blast_radius, initiative_id).

id.description: Unique per emission, '<lens>-NNNN'. NOT the dedup key — see dedup_key.

lens.description: Which Phase 2 lane emitted this. Determines which acceptance criterion applies.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion this finding must satisfy. Phase 3a applies exactly this; it may not improvise another.

criterion_is_mechanical.description: True only if the criterion is decidable without model judgement. Governs whether Phase 3b can produce non-model evidence. If false the finding can never reach Phase 5 auto-fix, regardless of 3a outcome.

locations.description: Every site involved. Duplication findings have >=2.

evidence.description: What supports the claim. Tool output outranks model reading.

tool.description: e.g. knip@5.x — required when kind is tool-output.

command.description: Exact command, so the evidence is reproducible.

proposed_fix.description: The smallest change that resolves it.

interface_delta.description: The objective function, made computable. Phase 4 reads this to apply the ineligibility rule. A lane that cannot compute it must set net_interface_change to 'unknown', which routes the finding to the structural track rather than auto-fix.

net_interface_change.description: 'reduces' is the only value that scores under the objective function.

removes_failure_path.description: The load-bearing-slack guard. Phase 4 makes any finding with value=true AND interface_delta.net_interface_change != 'reduces' INELIGIBLE for Phase 5 auto-fix, regardless of model confidence. Such findings route to the structural-plan track for human review.

value.description: True if the proposed fix removes a guard, error branch, retry, timeout, fallback, validation, or any other handler for a failure condition.

justification.description: Why true or false. A bare 'false' with no reasoning fails validation on length.

fix_size_loc.description: Estimated lines changed. Drives the 3a refuter-count rule.

touches_core.description: True if packages/core is affected. Forces 3 refuters.

verification_plan.description: How Phase 3b proves this without a model. CONSUMER: Phase 3b.

requires_mutation.description: True if verification requires editing the tree (e.g. remove symbol, build, run suite). Findings with this true MUST be verified in an isolated worktree — see SPEC Phase 3b.

initiative_id.description: Set by Phase 4 when this finding is grouped into a structural initiative. Null until then.

provenance.description: Who produced this. 'model' and 'effort' are stamped by the ORCHESTRATOR from the runtime pane footer, never self-reported by the lane — twux's registry EFFORT column records the launch flag, not the live setting.

nonce_verified.description: For proxied lanes: whether the codex-agent.sh nonce validated. False fails the lane.

dedup_key.description: sha256(sorted normalised locations + proposed_fix intent)[:16]. THE cross-lens dedup key: the same defect found by two lenses yields the same value, which an id embedding the lens cannot do. Phase 3 admission dedups on this before spending refuter budget.

allOf.description: A mutation experiment is only meaningful for a mechanical criterion.
Non-mechanical criteria cannot claim mechanical verifiability.
